Brand identity · Website · Product literature · Channel design

When your best-known products carry someone else’s name.

United Solutions makes Rubbermaid® storage under license, along with its own brands. I designed its website in two phases, in 2020 and 2022.

Client

United Solutions

Services

Website architecture and design, product literature

Phases

2020 and 2022

Brands

Rubbermaid®, Mighty Tuff™, ECOSense®

Home page, with the three brands at the foot of the hero.

The challenge

United Solutions makes Rubbermaid® storage under license, along with its own Mighty Tuff™ line and the ECOSense® eco line. Shoppers knew the products but not the company, and buyers needed specs fast.

Christine Dunn brought me in to architect and design a site that served both. We built it in two phases.

Two ways in. A brand story for shoppers, and eight category tiles.
Rubbermaid® gets its own full-width section.

Three brands, one maker

United Solutions produced and manufactured three brands. Each one got its own pages on the site.

Licensed

Rubbermaid®

ActionPacker®, Roughneck™ Totes and Cleverstore™, made under license.

House brand

Mighty Tuff™

United Solutions’ own brand.

Eco line

ECOSense®

Made from 100% recycled material and 100% recyclable, in its own hunter green.

Phase 1, 2020
Products first

I updated and streamlined the messages, cataloged every product and wrote the summaries. Most important, I organized how the products are presented.

The main Products page opens on a grid of categories, one image for each product line. A buyer goes straight to the product they need and sees related ones.

ActionPacker® page, with the lifetime warranty up front.

Phase 2, 2022
A brand manufacturer

CEO Dave Reilly repositioned United Solutions from a product solutions company to a brand manufacturer. By 2022 the company was launching the ECO line and hiring 100 people. The site had to show the brands and where the company was going.

  • The product video moved up the home page, next to the value sliders, to show what the company does.
  • Beside the video, two panels lead to Who We Are and What’s New.
  • “Trusted Solutions That Stand the Test of Time” now leads the Products section, with Storage and Organization and the ECO Line side by side. Product expansion mattered to investors.
  • The Products menu became a simple grid that can grow. ActionPacker, Roughneck Totes, Cleverstore, Trash and Recycling, Paint and Work Buckets, EcoSense and ECOSolutions.
  • A new Careers page with an application form supported the hiring push.
  • Sustainability messages moved to the ECO Line page.

I also recommended customer stories told as short case studies, each one proving a product claim like rugged, waterproof or durable.

Spec sheets list capacity, inside and outside dimensions, and temperature range. One layout works for web and print.
ECOSolutions page, in its own green.

Social channels

In 2020 I also built the company’s YouTube channel and Facebook page, and ran them until United Solutions was ready to take them over.

YouTube channel art, 2020.

The outcome

Phase 2 put product growth up front. In 2024, CREO Group acquired United Solutions.
